name: pdb-quickview
description: Searchable mirror of the wwPDB with precomputed PyMol thumbnails, served from SQLite behind nginx.
author: Daniel Kostro

scripts.dev: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d && concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.eslint: npm run eslint -w backend && npm run eslint -w frontend
scripts.eslint-fix: npm run eslint-fix -w backend && npm run eslint-fix -w frontend
scripts.prettier: npm run prettier -w backend && npm run prettier -w frontend
scripts.prettier-write: npm run prettier-write -w backend && npm run prettier-write -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test-only && npm run eslint && npm run prettier
